name: device-mockup
title: Device Mockup
description: A phone, browser or laptop frame drawn in CSS around real content (a screenshot or live markup). For a tall screenshot, pointing at the screen scrolls it slowly to the bottom, like someone reading.

meta.reducedMotion: The screen stays at the top; it can still be scrolled with the wheel or keyboard.
meta.useWhen: Showing the actual product screen (an app, a site you built) where the device tells the visitor where it runs.
meta.avoidWhen: Stock "phone with a gradient" decoration; floating several devices at angles; screens with fake data; when the screen alone, unframed, reads better.
